rgb_low_res.pixel_convention: Original unmirrored native pixels; x right, y down; zero-based coordinates
rgb_low_res.selection: Lowest held-out reprojection RMS of the evaluated k1, simple, and full models

rgb_high_res.pixel_convention: Original unmirrored native pixels; x right, y down; zero-based coordinates
rgb_high_res.selection: Lowest held-out reprojection RMS of the evaluated k1, simple, and full models

ir.pixel_convention: Original unmirrored native pixels; x right, y down; zero-based coordinates
ir.selection: Lowest held-out reprojection RMS of the evaluated k1, simple, and full models

depth.pixel_convention: Original unmirrored native pixels; x right, y down; zero-based coordinates
depth.derivation: IR K with principal point translated by accepted IR-to-depth shift; same IR lens distortion
depth.camera_coordinates: IR optical camera frame: x right, y down, Z forward; millimetres
depth.applies_to: Native unregistered 640x480 raw depth; undistort once before deprojection

ir_to_rgb.coordinate_convention: OpenCV camera coordinates: x right, y down, z forward
ir_to_rgb.low_res_application: Same physical camera pose, using the separately calibrated low-resolution RGB K and D; fit and direct cross-camera validation used high-resolution RGB

validation.definition: Source-camera-only board pose predicts target-camera corners; validation transform trained separately from the all-27-view final transform

measurement_limits.notes: Bootstrap is conditional on fixed intrinsics and 30 mm print pitch; handheld motion and common systematic errors are not included

ir_to_depth.nuisance_warning: These boundary terms are not optical corrections. Do not add them to image coordinates or principal points.
ir_to_depth.measurement_method: Independent IR front-outline gradients and raw-disparity plane-supported depth boundaries; quadrilateral outline, 12 mm side projection and boundary expansion modeled separately; complete-pair holdout
limitations: Depth plane membership can include 12 mm side surfaces; modeled thickness is a hypothesis, not direct side segmentation
Boundary processing can widen the depth silhouette; fitted outward bias is not an optical parameter
Left projector shadows are omitted; horizontal offset is coupled to outward boundary bias
Frame resampling excludes common systematic errors in edge selection and camera calibration
Front-face outline initialized from earlier IR measurements; mm lengths assume 30 mm print pitch
New IR outlines were visually seeded and refined with raw intensity gradients; thickness pose from four outline corners is approximate
Three cropped close-up boards and outlines with inconsistent full-face geometry are annotated but excluded from mapping
Isolated edge samples rejected by independent IR/depth smooth-curve residuals (1 / 1.25 px), before fitting the mapping

depth_encoding.metric_conversion: raw_depth_to_mm; device factory inverse disparity with accepted board-checked scale correction
depth_encoding.lut_encoding: Selected LUT: 2048 little-endian uint16 entries, round to nearest millimetre; reject nonphysical/out-of-range codes. Archived factory LUT contains unguarded entries outside its physical domain.
depth_encoding.metric_quantity: Axial Z in the IR camera coordinate frame, millimetres

factory_check.notes: Equivalent rigid approximation to the complete VGA factory polynomial mapping and depth shift, under measured intrinsics and accepted grid offset; not EEPROM R/T or independent distance validation

raw_depth_to_mm.validity: Raw code in 0..2047 and not 2047; factory denominator > 0; corrected 0 < Z_mm < 10000. Otherwise output 0. Raw code 0 is not the invalid sentinel.

lookup_table.encoding: 2048 little-endian uint16 entries, indexed by raw code; nearest whole millimetre; invalid output 0

raw_depth_to_mm.camera_coordinates: IR optical camera frame; x right, y down, Z forward; millimetres
raw_depth_to_mm.measurement_method: IR ChArUco pose supplies metric front-plane Z; sample printed-board interior using accepted depth-to-IR mapping and fixed IR intrinsics. Equal-frame robust scale fit; leave-one-frame-out validation; outline-only poses excluded from training.
raw_depth_to_mm.board_scale: Metric poses use accepted 30 mm ChArUco pitch; recovered physical outline agrees with independently supplied board sides. Four side lengths alone do not fix the board quadrilateral.
raw_depth_to_mm.selection_reason: One multiplicative correction preserves the factory reciprocal-disparity model and lowers held-out error. Offset and two-parameter inverse models have similar errors; extra degrees of freedom are not justified.
limitations: Accuracy is measured relative to the accepted IR board poses, not an independent laser/tape distance from the lens
Shared print scale, intrinsic, and planar-pose errors are absent from frame-bootstrap confidence
Old/new capture sessions disagree by several millimetres even after correction
Outline-only poses are checked separately and never train the conversion
Measured range is about 0.8–1.6 m. Errors outside this range were not measured
No per-pixel disparity correction is fitted; local pattern and surface-dependent errors remain

evidence.reference: Approximate prescribed camera directions; independent alignment not confirmed

limitations: Saved mesh is not ground truth.
Recorded original server build versus isolated cold replay; both exclude input decoding.
Live duplicate quarantine changes accepted evidence, so timings do not isolate geometry deferral.
Sparse/disconnected/failed tag maps fall back to general recovery.
